brief.scope: Owner adds lifecycle/usability requirement; INVESTIGATE ONLY, discuss before implementation. A new Claude/Codex/Grok conductor must onboard easily through understandable tools. Owner should start it and say onboard; never locate/pass a handoff hidden in a retained worktree. Existing Claude onboarding/closeout already handled placement and discovery: inspect its skills/settings plus ops/conductor/onboard-lever.md, handoff/README.md, tools/onboard.py and relevant closeout records. Main working checkout is ../../agentscient relative to the owning worktree. Report current behavior vs promises, canonical handoff placement/discovery, stale or multiple-session handling, and a small proposed start/onboard/work/close lifecycle. Identify the minimum conductor tool surface and operator commands; prefer existing instruments, no new orchestration platform. Read only; no code/tests/settings changes. Keep the report compact and source-stamped, exclude private values, and separate verified behavior from proposed design.

artifacts.verified_stale_and_multiple: At 161db7d, lexical AAR selection has no lineage, closed-at, supersedes, or current-head validation. `ops/conductor/AAR-2026-09-03T15-seat.md:9-13` already records the same-day filename-order defect. Two unsuperseded-looking closeout refs on 2026-09-05 demonstrate the multiple-session case, and `../../agentscient` was measured on an older dev head with owner WIP. Current onboarding can therefore serve a stale or unrelated thread without refusing or presenting alternatives.
artifacts.proposed_canonical_discovery: Keep the existing handoff/AAR/evidence paths and retained record branches, but make each closeout carry one small machine-readable manifest with session id, lineage, closed-at, baseline head, handoff/AAR paths, status, and optional supersedes id. Use a fixed record-ref namespace. `onboard` should discover refs with git plumbing and read blobs with `git show`; it must never traverse or require a retained worktree path. Validate manifests before serving their prose as untrusted data.
artifacts.proposed_selection_rules: If one closed, unsuperseded handoff matches the selected lineage, serve it and label facts stale when its baseline trails the freshly measured dev ref. If several parallel candidates remain, show compact session/lineage/baseline/age choices and ask the owner which thread—never pick by filename or mtime. Superseded records remain addressable history. Missing refs, incomparable ancestry, unreadable manifests, and an open session without a closeout are explicit expected-found-needed refusals or absences.
artifacts.proposed_lifecycle: Start: the operator runs `ops/bin/conductor.sh start <claude|codex|grok> -- <harness args...>`; the thin shim preserves `../../agentscient`, creates/selects an owned checkout from measured dev, installs the harness-specific conductor guard, records a session id, and execs the interactive CLI. Onboard: the owner says `onboard`; every harness invokes the same enhanced onboard service and receives law, live state, and discovered handoff candidates without a path. Work: root scopes, delegates with existing `ops/bin/go.sh` or `ops/bin/dispatch.sh`, observes with existing brief/record/wait/watch tools, rules, and lands through `land.py`; workers investigate or implement. Close: the owner says `close`; one closeout instrument remeasures state, writes the canonical manifest/handoff/AAR/probes on the retained record ref, marks the session closed, and reports the ref—not a worktree path. No merge, deletion, or automatic next work.
artifacts.proposed_minimum_surface: Minimum change surface: one thin start shim, an enhancement to the existing onboard instrument, and one closeout writer. Present the conductor with five understandable capabilities: `onboard`, `delegate`, `status`, `land`, and `close`. Reuse `onboard.py`, `go.sh`/`dispatch.sh`, lane brief/record plus launcher wait/watch, and `land.py`; decisions and handwork remain available when needed. MCP may project the same services but is not required for lifecycle correctness, and no new scheduler, daemon, broker platform, or hidden session-memory system is warranted.

envelope.note: The research-only change is internally consistent and should remain non-implementing. Current behavior does not yet satisfy the lifecycle promise; discuss canonical manifests, ambiguity handling, and the five-capability surface before authorizing contracts, tests, settings, or code.
